title: Beca Transforms Finance Operations with Oracle Fusion Applications
summary: Engineering and advisory firm leverages Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP to automate finance processes, improve insights, and increase operational efficiency
body_markdown:
Auckland, New Zealand—October 15, 2026


[Beca](https://www.beca.com/en-sg) , one of Asia Pacific’s largest independent advisory, design, and engineering consultancies, is using[Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications](https://www.oracle.com/anz/applications/) to support its mission of making every day better and building an enduring and resilient future for generations to come.


Founded in 1920, Beca has grown into an employee-owned business with more than 4,300 employees across 24 offices across the Asia Pacific region. As Beca continued to grow, it needed to replace its heavily customised finance system with a scalable cloud platform that could improve operational efficiency, support evolving risk and compliance requirements, and enable greater automation and data-driven decision-making. After careful evaluation, Beca decided to move its finance operations to Oracle Fusion Applications to address these challenges and support its growth.


"Beca is a project-driven business, and as we have grown, we needed to move beyond manual processes and equip our teams with the timely, trusted information to make better decisions," said Mark Fleming, chief financial officer, Beca. "Oracle Fusion Applications has helped us increase efficiency, improve visibility, and gain AI-powered insights that support better decision-making. As we adopt new agentic AI capabilities, we see significant opportunity to further transform finance processes, enabling our employees to apply their expertise to better serve clients and improve business outcomes."


With[Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)](https://www.oracle.com/anz/erp/) , Beca has been able to increase productivity, reduce costs, and strengthen controls. Building on these results, Beca is now exploring the use of Oracle Fusion Agentic Applications, to further automate procure-to-pay and supplier invoice processing.


"As advisory and consulting firms manage complex projects, distributed teams, and evolving client requirements, they need a connected view across operations and AI-powered insights that help improve performance," said Meredith Rowan, group vice president, Applications, Australia and New Zealand, Oracle. "With Oracle Cloud ERP, Beca has established a connected finance foundation that strengthens controls, automates routine processes, and creates new opportunities to apply agentic AI across finance. This frees its finance team to focus on delivering greater value across the business and to Beca's clients."


The implementation was led by Oracle PartnerNetwork (OPN) member,[Deloitte New Zealand](https://www.deloitte.com/nz/en.html) .

## About Beca


Beca is one of the largest employee-owned advisory, design and engineering consultancies in the Asia Pacific region, working across diverse infrastructure markets – including water, energy, defence, transport, buildings, industrial, community planning and climate resilience. With over a century of operation, and over 4,300 professionals across 24 offices, its employee ownership model means the value it creates helps power the local economies of the communities where its people work and live.


## About Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications


Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications are a complete suite of cloud applications that form the enterprise system of record, spanning finance, HR, supply chain, manufacturing, sales, service, and marketing. The suite includes[Oracle Fusion Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)](https://www.oracle.com/anz/erp/) ,[Oracle Fusion Cloud Human Capital Management (HCM)](https://www.oracle.com/anz/human-capital-management/) ,[Oracle Fusion Cloud Supply Chain & Manufacturing (SCM)](https://www.oracle.com/anz/scm/) , and[Oracle Fusion Cloud Customer Experience (CX)](https://www.oracle.com/anz/cx/) .


Fusion Agentic Applications extend that foundation into a system of outcomes. They can coordinate and execute end-to-end work toward business objectives, and are designed to operate within the policies, controls, and authority each organization defines. With Oracle AI Agent Studio for Fusion Applications, customers and partners can create, extend, and manage these agents and agentic applications combining trusted enterprise data with the security, data governance, and performance needed to operate at scale.
